source: 626 Blatant Malice
target: 626 Malitia Aperta

source: Naboredisley?
target: Naboredisley?

source: Lumian almost thought the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon was jesting with him.
target: Lumian paene existimavit daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis, cum illo iocari.

source: However, he swiftly confirmed a crucial detail.
target: Tamen celeriter confirmavit rem maximi momenti.

source: When it came to matters concerning the Love Incantation, he had never uttered the name Naboredisley!
target: Cum de incantatione amoris ageretur, nomen Naboredisley numquam edixit!

source: Not only did he fear that Naboredisley and the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon were adversaries, but he also adhered to Madam Magician’s instructions to abstain from writing or speaking this name.
target: Non solum timebat ne Naboredisley et daemon oculis glacie caeruleis adversarii essent, sed etiam mandata Dominae Magicae, ne hoc nomen scriberetur aut diceretur, observabat.

source: If so, why did the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon identify itself as Naboredisley?
target: Si ita, cur daemon oculis glacie caeruleis se "Naboredisley" appellavit?

source: Could it truly be the genuine Naboredisley?
target: Num vere esset verus Naboredisley?

source: Then, why did the repeated chanting of “Naboredisley” summon a different Demon and not the ice‑blue‑eyed one?
target: Ergo, cur repetita recitatio "Naboredisley" alium daemon evocavit, non autem illum oculis glacie caeruleis?

source: Or were they equals?
target: An aequales erant?

source: Was Naboredisley scheming to manipulate someone else into killing me?
target: Num Naboredisley machinabatur ut aliquem alium me interficeret?

source: Amidst Lumian’s astonishment and confusion, a smile crept onto his face.
target: Inter stuporem et confusionem, risus in facie eius apparuit.

source: “I wouldn’t dare utter that name.”
target: "Non ausus essem hoc nomen proferre."

source: He was testing the Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes.
target: Daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis tentabat.

source: The Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes turned towards Lumian.
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis versus Lumianum se convertit.

source: “You’ve heard of Naboredisley and are aware of the concealed perils of uttering this name?”
target: "Audivistine de Naboredisley et novistine pericula occulta huius nominis proferendi?"

source: “Yes,” Lumian replied with a grin.
target: "Ita," respondit Lumian cum risu.

source: From the Demon’s reaction, it seems unlikely to be the one propagating the Love Incantation…
target: Ex reactione daemonis vix videtur is fuisse qui incantationem amoris diffundat…

source: That’s intriguing… Lumian pondered.
target: Id mirum est… Lumian meditatus est.

source: Though this might unveil greater horrors and deeper secrets, as a Hunter, fear and curiosity didn’t contradict each other.
target: Quamquam hoc fortasse maiora horrores et arcana revelabit, ut Venator, timor et curiositas non erant contraria.

source: It was akin to how everyone in the army feared death, yet it didn’t deter them from banding together for combat.
target: Hoc simile erat eo, ut omnes in exercitu mortem timebant, sed eos non prohibebat coniungere ad pugnam.

source: The Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes nodded slowly and spoke, “Here, within Earth Mother’s cathedral, you needn’t fret about uttering the name Naboredisley.”
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis lente annuit et dixit: "Hic, in ecclesia Matris Terrae, non curare debes nomine 'Naboredisley' proferendo."

source: “That’s evidently not the name you typically go by.
target: Plane hoc non est nomen quo solito te appellare.

source: Why don’t you disclose your true name instead?”
target: Cur non enuntiās nomen verum tuum?

source: Lumian didn’t reply.
target: Lumian non respondit.

source: Instead, he posed a query.
target: Immo, quaestionem proposuit.

source: He had a persistent feeling that the other party intended to harm him.
target: Constanter sentiebat aliam partem sibi nocere intentasse.

source: Had he not encountered the Love Incantation and received guidance from Madam Magician, he might have inadvertently mentioned the concealed Demon on Hanth Island, Naboredisley, after leaving Earth Mother’s cathedral today.
target: Si incantationem amoris non invenisset et Dominae Magicae consilium non accepisset, forsitan inopinato, postquam ecclesiam Matris Terrae hodie relicta esset, daemon occultus in Insula Hanth, Naboredisley, memoratus fuisset.

source: That could have been troublesome!
target: Id grave esse poterat!

source: The Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes fell silent for a few moments before stating, “The name I go by in human society holds no significance for you.
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis paucos instantes siluit, deinde dixerat: "Nomen quod in societā humanā utor, tibi nihil refert.

source: Moreover, after learning the name Naboredisley and uttering it at least three times outside the cathedral…
target: Praeterea, postquam nomen Naboredisley didicit et saltem ter extra ecclesiam proferuit…

source: At this juncture, the white‑haired Demon’s visage twitched, and a pained expression surfaced.
target: In hoc momento, vultus daemonis albis capillis contremuit, et vultus doloris apparuit.

source: “I will establish a connection with you.
target: "Tecum nexum instituam.

source: When I can no longer control myself, I may choose to end your life.
target: "Cum me ipsum regere non potero, fortasse eligam vitam tuam finire.

source: Ending the life of an uninformed adventurer like you, seeking to uncover the truth of Hanth Island’s legend, would bring me greater satisfaction than harming ordinary people.
target: "Vitam viatoris ignoti, ut te, qui veritatem de legenda Insulae Hanth detegere conaris, interficere, mihi maiorem voluptatem attulerit quam vulgos laedere.

source: I won’t feel as regretful or guilty.
target: "Non me paenitebit et non culpam sentiam.

source: The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon gazed at the Sacred Emblem of Life once more, bowed its head, and expressed remorse.
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis iterum Emblema Sacrum Vitae spectavit, caput inclinavit, et poenitentiam ostendit.

source: “Oh, merciful Mother, I implore your mercy for my transgressions.
target: "O mater misericors, veniam tuam pro peccatis meis imploro.

source: I should not have harbored malevolent intentions…
target: "Non debui malevolas intentiones fovere…

source: The corners of Lumian’s mouth twitched, and his expression darkened.
target: Anguli oris Luminiani titubaverunt, et vultus eius obscuratus est.

source: Did you genuinely intend to harm me?
target: Num vere propositum habuisti mihi nocere?

source: He couldn’t afford to let his guard down for a moment when dealing with Demons.
target: Non potuit quidem momentum relinquere custodiam, cum daemonibus ageret.

source: Vigilance was paramount, even if it was a Demon professing allegiance to Earth Mother!
target: Praecipua erat vigilantia, etiamsi daemon Matri Terrae fidem praestaret!

source: Moreover, a seemingly innocuous conversation could clandestinely plant a time bomb.
target: Praeterea, sermo parvus innocuus videbatur, sed occulte bombam temporis instillare poterat.

source: Any other adventurer would have fallen victim to it.
target: Alius quilibet viator victima eius fuisset.

source: Truly befitting the Criminal pathway, known for its high IQ crimes…
target: Vere decet iter criminale, notum prae scelera ingenii excelsi…

source: Cold, calculating, and overtly malicious…
target: Frigidus, calculans, et manifeste malitiosus…

source: After the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, self‑identified as Naboredisley, concluded its repentance, Lumian feigned a nonchalant smile and remarked,
target: Post daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, se vocans Naboredisley, paenitentiam confectum, Lumian risum indifferens simulavit et dixit:

source: “If you truly cannot control yourself and desire to take a life, target pirates.
target: "Si vere teipsum regere non potes et animam tollere cupis, piratas intende.

source: It aligns with a sense of justice.”
target: "Id iustitiae sensui congruit.

source: The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon’s expression darkened as it retorted, “This is my prison.
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis vultu obscurato respondit: "Hic est carcer meus.

source: I cannot depart until I have atoned.
target: "Non possum discedere, nisi paenitentiam egerim.

source: If any pirates enter Port Hanth, I will make them vanish into the forest outside the city.”
target: "Si quid piratarum in Portum Hanth ingrediatur, eos in silva extra urbem evanescere faciam.

source: Lumian nodded and redirected the conversation.
target: Lumian annuit et colloquium dirigere conatus est.

source: “The Love Incantation I mentioned earlier was the name you brought up.
target: "Incantatio Amoris, quam antea commemoravi, erat nomen, quod tu proposuisti.

source: The Demon who proposed a deal with me also identified itself with that name.”
target: "Daemon, qui mihi pactum proposuit, quoque se hoc nomine designavit.

source: The gray‑haired, ice‑blue‑eyed Demon remained silent, gazing at the Sacred Emblem of Life for an extended period.
target: Daemon cineraceo capillato, oculis glacie caeruleis, silentium retinuit et Emblema Sacrum Vitae diu contemplavit.

source: Rather than detecting anger and animosity, Lumian sensed surprise and bewilderment.
target: Potius quam iram et inimicitias deprehendens, Lumian admirationem et stupefactionem sensit.

source: What… It can’t pinpoint the Demon’s true identity either?
target: Quid... Nec veram daemonis identitatem determinare potest?

source: Is there no direct connection between the two parties?
target: Nonne inter has duas partes directa connexio existit?

source: Lumian pondered inwardly.
target: Lumian intime meditatus est.

source: After a while, the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, self‑dubbed Naboredisley, spoke,
target: Post aliquod tempus, daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, se vocans Naboredisley, locutus est,

source: “According to you, the Love Incantation has been clandestinely circulating for many years, yet I’ve never established a connection with anyone outside Hanth Island.”
target: "Secundum te, incantatio amoris per multos annos clandestine circulavit, attamen cum nemine extra Insulam Hanth connexus sum.

source: “I’m puzzled by that too.
target: "Illo quoque miror.

source: Could it be that someone can intercept the direction of the name?
target: Num aliquis directionem nominis intercipere possit?

source: Is it conceivable to assume your identity in the future?”
target: Num fieri potest ut in futurum identitatem tuam suscipias?

source: Lumian feigned curiosity as an adventurer.
target: Lumian, ut viator, curiositatem simulavit.

source: He believed that, based on Madam Magician’s words, Mr. Fool could accomplish such a feat.
target: Credebat, ex verbis Dominae Magicae innixus, Dominum Stultum talem rem perfacere posse.

source: Amon was capable of it once too.
target: Amon quoque olim id efficaciter perfecit.

source: Whether any Demon could do it remained unknown for now.
target: Num quisquam daemon id facere posset adhuc ignotum manet.

source: The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon fell silent once more.
target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis iterum tacuit.

source: After a few seconds, it spoke with a deep voice,
target: Post paucas secundas, profunda voce locutus est,

source: “Foreigner, you’ve inquired enough.
target: "Hospes, satis quaesivisti.

source: “Let’s conclude it here.
target: "Hoc hic confingamus.

source: “Otherwise, you may meet your end unknowingly.”
target: "Aliter, ignaro, fatum tuum continget.

source: Clad in a formal black suit, the Demon self‑dubbed Naboredisley slowly rose.
target: Indutus habitu nigro formali, daemon, se vocans Naboredisley, lente surrexit.

source: It positioned its feet apart, raised its hands adorned with black leather gloves, and whispered,
target: Pedes se dispositos, manus, chirothecis nigris coriaceis induti, tollens, susurravit,

source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: "Lauda Terram, lauda Matrem Omnium!

source: Then, it turned around, picked up its cane, and shuffled towards the cathedral’s door, bathed in the midday sun.
target: Deinde se vertit, baculum assumpsit, et ad ostium cathedralis, sub sole meridiano, laboriose accessit.

source: Lumian scrutinized the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, realizing it wasn’t tall and appeared rather thin.
target: Lumian daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis diligenter examinavit, animadvertens eum non esse altum atque tenue videbatur.

source: It emitted a withered and feeble aura, resembling that of an elderly ordinary human.
target: Emanabat ab eo aura marcescens atque infirmissima, similis habitu senis hominis communis.

source: It hardly resembled a terrifying and mighty Demon.
target: Vix remanet daemon terribilis et potens.

source: Observing closely, Lumian sensed a dark, blatant malice expanding and contracting beneath the thin human skin and aged flesh.
target: Attente observans, Lumian sensit malitiam obscuram et manifesta, quae sub tenuo cuti humanae et carne senili expandebatur atque contrahiebatur.

source: The frightening inner core sharply contrasted with its frail appearance, yet the overall aura seemed feeble and commonplace.
target: Intima essentia daemonis terribilis acuite contraria apparatu fragile eius erat, sed aura universalis videbatur debilis atque vulgata.

source: This is reminiscent of Ludwig…
target: Hoc Ludwig reminiscit…

source: One is a child concealing an unknown monster beneath the skin, while the other is a pitch‑black Demon concealed within an old man’s body…
target: Unus est puer qui monstrum ignotum sub cute celat, alter autem est daemon ater, in corpore senilis absconditus…

source: Lumian exerted great effort to refrain from fixating on scrutinizing the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon’s luck.
target: Lumian magnum conatum cepit, ne fortunam daemonis oculis glacie caeruleis perscruteret.

source: The gray‑haired elder in black leather gloves, wielding a cane, slowly departed from the cathedral.
target: Senex cineraceus, indutus chirothecis nigris ex coriaceo, baculo utens, cathedralem lente reliquit.

source: Lumian wasn’t in a rush to return to the Berries.
target: Lumian ad Berries redire non festinabat.

source: He remained seated in the first row, contemplating the local Demon legends, which had recently become clearer yet were shrouded in numerous mysteries.
target: In prima ordine sedebat, de fabulis daemonum localium meditans, quae nuper clariora facta erant sed adhuc multis mysteriis tectae.

source: Suddenly, from the corner of his eye, he spotted a brown clergyman’s uniform.
target: Subito, ex angulo oculi sui, vestem clericorum fuscorum animadvertit.

source: This was the attire of a clergyman from the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Haec erant vestimenta clerici Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

source: Lumian looked up and saw a middle‑aged man with well‑defined facial features and thick eyebrows.
target: Lumian extulit oculos et virum medii aetatis, faciei bene definitæ et superciliis crassioribus, vidit.

source: He noticed a pair of blood‑shot, ice‑blue‑eyed eyes filled with pain.
target: Animadvertit par oculorum rubentium, oculis glacie caeruleis, dolore repletos.

source: Ice‑blue eyes?
target: Oculi glacie caerulei?

source: Dammit! Lumian’s hair stood on end as he cursed inwardly.
target: Pro di immortales! Capilli Luminiani erecti sunt, dum interius maledixit.

source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman sat beside Lumian, where the Demon had been.
target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis iuxta Lumian sedebat, in loco ubi daemon fuerat.

source: He smiled warmly and said, “Don’t provoke Boselli or attempt his suggestions.
target: Calide subridens dixit: "Noli Bosellim provocare neque eius consilia temptare.

source: His self‑control diminishes with age.”
target: "Eius continentia cum aetate minuit.

source: “Boselli? Are you referring to the old gentleman with ice‑blue eyes?” Lumian feigned ignorance.
target: "Boselli? Num de viro seniore cum oculis glacie caeruleis loqueris?" Lumian ignorantiam simulavit.

source: “Yes.”
target: "Ita."

source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman nodded slightly.
target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis leviter annuit.

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and grinned.
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et risum afferre coepit.

source: “What about you? How’s your self‑control?”
target: "Quid de te? Quomodo tua continentia est?"

source: “I’m much better than him.
target: "Multo melius quam ille sum.

source: I lose control only once every few years,” the ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman replied candidly.
target: "Continentiam solum semel in aliquot annis perdo," respondit clericus oculis glacie caeruleis sincera voce.

source: Is he admitting that he’s also a Demon?
target: Num ille agnoscit se quoque daemonem esse?

source: I’m not in Earth Mother’s cathedral, but a Devil family’s dining room…
target: Non in ecclesia Matris Terrae sum, sed in triclinio familiae Diaboli…

source: Lumian felt a chill and couldn’t help but criticize.
target: Lumian frigore affectus est et non potuit non reprehendere.

source: Maintaining a composed smile, he said, “Are you acquainted with him? Are you from the same family?”
target: Tranquillum risum servans, dixit: "Illum cognoscisne? Eadem familia esne?"

source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman reflected for a moment and replied, “We’re all born in the Port Hanth Cloister.”
target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis paulisper meditatus est et respondit: "Omnes in Claustro Portus Hanth nati sumus."

source: Children born in a cloister?
target: Pueri in claustro nati?

source: The description made Lumian uneasy.
target: Descriptio Luminian inquietum fecit.

source: In other Churches, having a child in a cloister was a grave matter, deviating from the teachings of the deity, a symptom of succumbing to carnal desires and blaspheming faith.
target: In aliis Ecclesiis, puer in claustro nascitur gravis quaestio erat, a doctrina deitatis deviante, signum ad desideria carnalia cedendi ac fidei blasphemii.

source: Lumian pondered for a moment before reaching a realization.
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est antequam intellectum assequeretur.

source: This was the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Haec erat Ecclesia Matris Terrae.

source: The more nuns and monks had children in the cloister, the more aligned with the doctrine!
target: Quo plura moniales et monachi in claustro nati sunt, eo magis doctrinae congruunt!

source: He immediately understood why the ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman and Boselli were born in the cloister.
target: Statim intellexit cur clericus oculis glacie caeruleis et Boselli in claustro nati essent.

source: It would conceal their origins and identities well, preventing them from implicating ordinary families.
target: Eorum originem et identitatem bene celabit, ne familiis ordinariis implicarentur.

source: This shattered Lumian’s previous deductions about the local Demons.
target: Hoc praevias coniecturas Luminiani de daemonibus localibus fregit.

source: Demons didn’t need to vanish to conceal their “corpses.”
target: Daemonibus non necesse fuit evanescere ut "cadavera" sua celarent.

source: The Church of Earth Mother would assist in concealing them.
target: Ecclesia Matris Terrae eos celare adiuvabit.

source: For instance, replacing genuine holy water with distilled water during a wake and later providing new identities and legal origins.
target: Exempli causa, aquam sanctam veram aqua destillata substituendo in vigilia funebri et postea identitates novas originisque legales praebendo.

source: My earlier deduction was based on the assumption that the Church of Earth Mother and the local Demons weren’t allies.
target: Praevia mea coniectura innixabatur suppositione quod Ecclesia Matris Terrae et daemonia localia non erant socia.

source: No wonder there are so many errors…
target: Non mirum plurima esse errores…

source: This is a factor I need to be mindful of when crafting conspiracies in the future.
target: Hoc est factor, quem meminisse debeo dum coniurationes futuras extruo.

source: If I’m mistaken, any subsequent clever arrangements will lose their significance…
target: Si erraverim, quaevis subsequentes callidae consilia significationem amittent…

source: It seems the Church of Earth Mother is directly offering protection to these ice‑blue‑eyed Demons, both resisting restrictions and cooperating to shield them?
target: Videtur Ecclesia Matris Terrae directe hos daemonos oculis glacie caeruleis protegere, simul restrictionibus resistere et cooperari ut eos tueatur?

source: Lumian reflected on his investigations over the past two days.
target: Lumian de indagationibus per duas dies praeteritas meditatus est.

source: This introspection couldn’t enable him to digest the potion completely, but he felt it was more beneficial than a complete digestion.
target: Haec introspectio eum potionem omnino digere non potuit, sed sensit id magis utile esse quam completa digestio.

source: Lumian gazed at the clergyman with ice‑blue eyes and inquired with a smile, “Could it be that you’re also using the name Boselli mentioned just now?”
target: Lumian ad clericum oculis glacie caeruleis spectavit et subridente quaesivit: "Num fortasse etiam nomen, quod Boselli modo dixit, uteris?"

source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman responded with a warm smile.
target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis cum risu calido respondit.

source: “Yes, my name is also Naboredisley.”
target: "Ita, nomen meum quoque est Naboredisley."

source: Without waiting for Lumian to probe further, it continued, “I don’t know your background, but you can report Hanth Island to the other orthodox Churches.
target: Ne Lumian ulterius indagare exspectans, perrexit: "Nescio quid tua sit origo, sed Insulam Hanth alias Ecclesias orthodoxas referre potes.

source: “I believe they will advise you against delving into the truth of the Demon legends.
target: "Credo eos te monere, ne veritatem fabularum daemonum investiges.

source: “Just as Boselli mentioned, Foreigner, let’s conclude this here.
target: "Sicut Boselli dixit, hospes, hoc hic finiamus.

source: “Leave Hanth Island.”
target: "Relinque Insulam Hanth.

source: Lumian nodded, stood up, and departed from the cathedral.
target: Lumian annuit, surrexit, et ex ecclesia discessit.

source: Under the bright sunlight, he strolled along the street, his mind filled with pairs of icy‑blue eyes and the name Naboredisley.
target: Sub luce solis clarae, per viam ambulavit, mente plena pariorum oculorum glacie caeruleorum et nominis Naboredisley.

source: He felt a little disoriented.
target: Aliquantum disorientatus se sensit.
